member.name: M:BTCPayServer.Abstractions.TagHelpers.PermissionedFormTagHelper.SubmitButtonRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
<(button|input).*?type="submit".*?>.*?</\\1>
Explanation:
○ Match '<'.
○ 1st capture group.
○ Match with 2 alternative expressions.
○ Match the string "button".
○ Match the string "input".
○ Match a character other than '\n' lazily any number of times.
○ Match the string "type=\"submit\"".
○ Match a character other than '\n' lazily any number of times.
○ Match '>'.
○ Match a character other than '\n' lazily any number of times.
○ Match the string "</".
○ Match the same text as matched by the 1st capture group.
○ Match '>'.
